-    Tinea versicolor, extensive + recurr: PO antifungals (pts prefer for convenience, but more AEs — liver damage, harmful DI → use sparingly); fluconazole = safest PO agent, wkly x2–4 wk; once every 6 mo if ↑risk of recurr
-    Ketoconazole: ⍉1st-line PO agent d/t risk of drug-induced hepatitis
-    Ketoconazole: ⇣cortisol in Cushing dz when ⍉surg candidate (w/ cabergoline, metyrapone)
-    Tinea capitis: topical tx ineffective → PO antifungal — griseofulvin (1st-line), terbinafine (alt 1st-line), itraconazole (if 1st-line tx fail)

roles.drugs: Topical, to cut spread (⍉enough alone): imidazole or ciclopirox cream to the scalp; selenium sulfide 2.5% shampoo at least twice a wk
Severe inflam or kerion: short prednisone course, tapered over 2 wks
Household contacts: screen all; tx aSx carriers (antifungal or selenium shampoo for 2–4 wks)
Trichophyton: PO terbinafine (MSD first-line for Trichophyton, and for adults; AAFP preferred, SORT A, shorter course than griseofulvin)
